odd: Across headings the menu order holds: "chicken" lists Grilled chicken (Sides) and Caesar salad — With chicken (Salads) before Chicken schnitzel (Mains) and puts Chicken soup (Kids) last, though both names start with the word (picture 08). Within a heading the best match is first (Chicken schnitzel above Honey balsamic chicken). cmdk 1.1.1 tries to move the best group up but looks groups up by an internal id against the heading, so groups never move.
"water" lists Fresh watermelon juice first (Juice heading comes before Soft drinks), then the three waters.
"fry" finds nothing (singular of fries); "margarita" finds nothing (the menu spells Margherita).
"nugget" finds only "ZZ TEST 829 nuggets" (Party only); "juice" also lists "ZZ TEST 829 juice" (Party only): two earlier test items still on the staging till as BEO-only products.
"bar" lists Barley & quinoa warm salad first, then every bar item (found by station); "kids" lists the 8 Kids dishes and the 4 Kids juices (by category).
